_comment: Search metadata for App Cloud applets, by app id. toolbox.appletEntry uses it for any applet that registered without its own description or tags (an applet's own wins), so tool_list finds the applets that already exist. Add an entry when an applet is published; mesh_app_register / app-publish take description and tags directly.

krea-studio.description: Krea Studio (original Python app on port 8190): image studio on your own ComfyUI with prompt styles, text-to-image, image-to-image and upscale.

krea-studio-comfy.description: Krea Studio (RIGS applet): Krea-style image studio on your own ComfyUI with text-to-image, image-to-image from upload or sketch, upscale, realtime mode and a history gallery.

live-video.description: Live Video (original Python app on port 8211): live generated video on a local GPU.

live-video-comfy.description: Live Video (RIGS applet): realtime generated video through your own ComfyUI, with GPU-overseer leases and a settings panel.

navigation.description: Navigation: turn-by-turn trip navigation with live map, speed readout, speed-camera and speed-limit warnings, and recorded trips.

acestep-studio.description: ACE-Step Studio: music generation with ACE-Step 1.5, songs from a caption and lyrics, covers, repaint and a jukebox.

gpu-overseer.description: GPU Overseer: keeps shared GPU apps from running out of VRAM; apps acquire a VRAM lease before loading a model and idle holders are unloaded to make room.

grok-agent.description: Grok Agent: the grok.com web chat driven through a headless Chromium with your own signed-in profile, as a local agent with a tool loop (shell, files, web fetch, RIGS mesh) and approvals.

jarvis-voice.description: JARVIS Voice: JARVIS's own neural voice (Kokoro text-to-speech with a lipsync timeline) and Whisper speech-to-text for the microphone.

localjev.description: LocalJev (emotions): local Jev-compatible POST /v1/systemone API on Bun, backed by DiffusionGemma through an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint.

worldview.description: Worldview: RIGS host for the kevtoe/worldview app, serving its built frontend and forwarding its API and websocket.

props-studio.description: 3D Props Studio: the Mad Max game's props dashboard for reviewing and iterating 3D props.

szuf.description: SZÜF license-plate lookup: type a Hungarian plate to scrape the official portal and show traffic, insurance, MOT and wanted status in a mobile UI.

op1-screen.description: OP-1 Field Screen: live viewer of the OP-1 Field emulator's display (screen viewer of the OP-1 emulator harness).

body-matching.description: Body Matching: host app running on the MacBook (started through a LaunchAgent).

quanto-overseer-dashboard.description: Quanto overseer dashboard: web view of the Quanto /overseer state plus a request queue for it.

quanto-guideline-book.description: Quanto guideline book: browse generated art-direction variants per item, pick favourites with notes, and re-roll a variant through ComfyUI.
